svg.text: DATA port: USB 2.0 device, separate 5.1k Rd on each CC. PD POWER must supply the controller; computer 5V does not power logic or the motor.
Q_DATA_PRESENT insulates PC VBUS from RP2040 GPIO29 and V3V3. GPIO low means VBUS present. Firmware enables USB pull-up only with computer VBUS present; advertise self-powered.
No diode OR or power link to PD VBUS/VM. 10k/100k resistors limit VBUS sensing to about45uA at5V; the MOSFET gate divider stays below its gate rating.
J_DATA: COMPUTER USB-C; USB data, isolated 5 V VBUS.
R_DATA_CC1: 5.1 kohm; independent CC1 Rd to ground.
R_DATA_CC2: 5.1 kohm; independent CC2 Rd to ground.
D_USB: TPD2EUSB30; protects the data pair from ESD.
R_DATA_SENSE_TOP: 10 kohm; limits VBUS gate current.
R_DATA_SENSE_OFF: 100 kohm; defines absent VBUS state.
Q_DATA_PRESENT: gate senses VBUS; isolates PC power.
